719-3277-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
719-3277-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Xenograft, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Izzet Chronarch token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5531-6620-6621-8345.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
5531-6620-6621-8345.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3897-4288.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Terramorphic Expanse.
1479-2841-3897-4288.description:
Fetch a land using Terramorphic Expanse.
When the fetched land enters, Sarinth Greatwurm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2693-4693-5721-6763.easyPrerequisites: Land cards in your graveyard and under your control can tap to add at least {4}{G}{B}.
2693-4693-5721-6763.description:
Activate each untapped land you control by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it.
In response, activate Overgrown Estate repeatedly by sacrificing each land you control, gaining life each time.
Resolve the Aftermath Analyst ability, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Activate Phyrexian Reclamation by paying {1}{B} and 2 life, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G}.
Aftermath Analyst enters, triggering itself, causing you to mill three cards.

413-789-1580-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Gutter Grime and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

2034-4518-4986--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kor Skyfisher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kor Skyfisher
Repeat.
2034-4518-4986--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

967-2511-3809-6441-7087.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

821-2173-5220-5708.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

147-3890-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
147-3890-5147.description:
Cast Unearth by paying {B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}. 
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Unearth.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unearth, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Unearth copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1495-2060-5544-6431-6798.manaNeeded: {B} if Crystalline Crawler does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
1495-2060-5544-6431-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
If able, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Triskelion ability from step 3.
Repeat.

5972-5973-6798.easyPrerequisites:
Griffin Guide attached to another creature you control.
You control an additional creature beyond those included above and the one that has Griffin Guide attached.
5972-5973-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature with Griffin Guide attached.
When the creature dies, Cass and Griffin Guide trigger.
Resolve the Griffin Guide trigger, creating a 2/2 Griffin creature token.
Resolve the Cass trigger, returning Griffin Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

338-360-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-360-4186.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-4186-6719.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-4186-6719.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1495-4120-6758.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn.
1495-4120-6758.notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
1495-4120-6758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, attempting to deal 100 damage to Triskelion, but instead putting 100 +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion 100 times by removing 100 +1/+1 counters from it, dealing 100 damage divided among any number of targets.
1495-4120-6758.notes: You can forego step 2 if you just want the counters. Alternatively, you can target creatures you control in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them.

2468-6636-6637.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers, casting a copy of Stitch in Time without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Stitch in Time, causing you to flip a coin, which will be heads due to Edgar, and take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2196-2821-3230-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
2196-2821-3230-5803.description:
Activate Coral Atoll and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap Minamo, Coral Atoll and another land.
Activate Coral Atoll and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kitsa.
Repeat from step 4.

1432-2821-3201-6202.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant or sorcery card in hand with mana to cast it.
Ioreth of the Healing House and Minamo do not have summoning sickness.
Arixmethes is a creature and does not have summoning sickness.
1432-2821-3201-6202.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost.
Noyan Dar triggers, causing Minamo to become a creature with haste.
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House's second ability by tapping it, untapping Minamo and Arixmethes.
Repeat from step 3.

2511-6103-6105.description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, causing you to choose how players vote this turn and drawing a card.
Cast Magister of Worth by paying {4}{W}{B}.
When Magister of Worth enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Magister of Worth and any number of other creatures.
Resolve the Magister of Worth trigger, having each player vote for grace, returning all creatures from graveyards to the battlefield.
Resolve all abilities from step 4, putting +1/+1 counters on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Repeat from 3.

7-658-3544-4050-5751.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-658-3544-4050-5751.description:
Cast Auramancer from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {W} and discarding Urza's Saga.
When Auramancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Urza's Saga from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Auramancer, adding {W}.
Repeat.

277-1409-2895-3147.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
277-1409-2895-3147.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Holding priority, activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.

222-2034-3719.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
222-2034-3719.description:
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning Slimefoot and Squee and Ruthless Technomancer to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Ruthless Technomancer enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Ruthless Technomancer trigger, causing you to sacrifice Slimefoot and Squee and create three Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ruthless Technomancer, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2070-3858.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped creatures, two or which are green.
2070-3858.description:
Cast Ancient Imperiosaur by tapping seven untapped creatures you control, two of which must be green.
Ancient Imperiosaur enters the battlefield with fourteen +1/+1 counters on it.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life, and win the game.

1908-3750-4891.notablePrerequisites: You have cast at least one instant and/or sorcery this turn.
1908-3750-4891.description:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, Rionya triggers, creating at least two copies of Atsushi with haste.
Put all but the nontoken Atsushi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each Atsushi token triggers, creating a total of at least six Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and getting an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

225-539-1257-3861.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Walking Atlas as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.
